_comment: Multi-table extract config: one block per distinct domestic FD rate table on bankofbaroda.bank.in (callable & non-callable up to ten crores). Mirrors lib/templating/llm_propose.js output. idx=0 = retail <3Cr (tenure/general/senior/super-senior). idx=1 = bulk 3Cr-5Cr amount-tiered table (7 identical bulk-tier rate columns per row → coalesced to one slab per tenure). Header band on idx=1 spans rows 0-1; data starts row 2.
